capabilities: Turn any note or folder item into a todo list with sections from headings
Add, tick, star, tag, date, repeat, select and drag-reorder items
Write Markdown notes on items with a formatting toolbar and web paste
Filter lists by text, date, star and tag, including archived items
See dated items from all lists in a Schedule sidebar grouped by due date
extras: The plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the README documents privacy behavior (no network requests, no account), known limits on iOS image drops and Obsidian Sync conflicts, and points to a separate design document for the full list format.
problem: Obsidian's core task lists only render checkboxes inline, with no list UI for sections, dates, tags, filtering or a view of dated items across notes.

relations.evidence: Works with Tasks: dates use the Tasks plugin's format.

summary: Task list view that turns plain Markdown notes into interactive todo lists with sections, dates, tags, repeats and a cross-list Schedule.
